brief.text: Charli xcx, Billie Eilish - Guess featuring billie eilish
brief.understood: User is pointing to the specific Charli xcx track “Guess” featuring Billie Eilish and wants its distinctive production identity captured, not a generic Charli/Billie description.

instrumentalProfile.vocalSpace: hyper‑featured dual‑vocal space: intimate close‑miked leads in front; tight doubles and whispers used rhythmically; interplay between Charli’s and Billie’s tones is the main ‘lead instrument ’ with the beat leaving them plenty of room.

genre.reason: Charli XCX x Billie Eilish collaboration implies a hybrid of Charli’s experimental pop and Billie’s moody alt‑pop; title‑level knowledge places it firmly in the modern alt‑pop/electro‑pop lane.

groove.reason: Both artists commonly favor mid‑tempo, groove‑driven tracks with understated bounce; a feature track is unlikely to be hyper‑fast EDM or a ballad and more likely a cool, head‑nod pace.

bass.reason: Charli’s recent work and Billie/Finneas productions both rely on expressive, often sub‑heavy synth bass as a structural element with occasional movement but not busy melodic runs.

instruments.reason: A Charli x Billie track will almost certainly be electronic and vocal‑forward, built on synths and programmed drums; guitars, pianos or live bands are less central in their shared aesthetic.

arrangement.reason: Both artists tend toward modern, sectional arrangements that use space and contrast instead of maximal pop layering; a feature track likely exploits that by giving each singer clear sections and interplay rather than a wall of sound.

energy.reason: Combining Charli’s avant‑pop with Billie’s intimate, dark aesthetic skews toward controlled, tension‑driven energy instead of festival‑EDM peaks; emotional intensity over sheer loudness.

balance.reason: Production in both catalogs is designed to showcase vocals and lyrics, with low‑end presence and tight high‑frequency detail; midrange clutter is usually avoided.

activity.reason: Their tracks often feel minimal at a distance but reveal fine transient and FX detail on close listening; fills and ear candy are purposeful, not constant.

timbreSpace.reason: Shared aesthetic: dark‑leaning, glossy digital timbres with some bass saturation and clean, modern top end; not analog‑retro or organic‑band focused.

vocalSpace.reason: A Charli x Billie feature centers on vocal character and interplay; both are known for close, intimate vocal production with creative doubles and harmonies, so the mix will leave them as the clear focal point.
